title: Great tour!
text: A couple hours with Juan to jump start our visit to Seville was perfect! We learned a lot of history from a proud local, interesting and fun. Juan also gave us some great recommendations for the rest of our stay. I highly recommend!

title: Fantastic start to our Sevilla trip!!
text: Truly a must-do tour on your initial days in Sevilla. Juan is very knowledgeable about the history of Sevilla and its importance in world history. He is personable and easy going - a fantastic guide to start your trip to Sevilla. We would absolutely do a tour with Juan again.
author: Nicole C

title: Gorgeous guide
text: Absolutely loved the 3-hour Highlight Tour of Seville! The guide showed us the best of the city, from historic landmarks to hidden local spots. Perfect pace, lots of fascinating stories, and a really authentic experience of Seville’s culture and history. Highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see the city in a few hours!
